notes.title: Developer Q&A Session#2
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44041559/1f49d40273476cd0ef166e90211b97c1fa347650.png[/img]

Dear Niwarners,
Here are the answers from the development team to the questions submitted by the players.
The Home Sweet Home: Online development team would like to thank everyone who has submitted questions. 
If anyone wishes to ask further questions, you can do so at [url=https://homesweethomegame.com/en/Q&ADeveloper]this link[/url]. 
We'll see you again in the next session.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[b][Developer Q&A Session#2][/b]

[b]Q1[/b]:Why are various issues taking so long to be resolved ?
[b]A[/b]:Due to limitations in our working processes, game issue resolutions have to be prioritized. This results in lower-priority issues being addressed slowly.

Conversely, for some high-priority issues, the development team may not pinpoint a clear cause. For example, some players are unable to play the Mewmew character. Addressing problems without a known cause contributes to delays in the resolution process.



[b]Q2[/b]:Principles for considering character balance adjustments
[b]A[/b]:The current character balance adjustments are based on usage statistics, win-loss ratios, as well as the utilization of Perk, Curse and Relic in ranked mode. Characters or skills with excessively high or low win rates or selection rates are considered for balance in that particular season.



[b]Q3[/b]:In the future, will the Ranked Mode add a Pick/Ban system or any additional features?
[b]A[/b]:The development team will reconsider the mentioned system in the future. If there are clear conclusions or development directions for the system, it will be announced it in the future.



[b]Q4[/b]:Is there a plan to adjust Devil's Intervention, Perk of Warden?
[b]A[/b]:The development team currently has no plans to update the existing Perk.



[b]Q5[/b]:Is it possible to bring back the flash effect / add more gameplay and uniqueness to the levels?
[b]A[/b]:The flashing light is considered one of the Visual Cues for the Spector Mode skill in the game Home Sweet Home: Survive (OBT1). Currently, this skill has been incorporated into the Corpse's Hair, (Curse of Kamiko) leading to the removal of the flashing light Visual Cue. This adjustment is made to align the capabilities of the skill with the current style of gameplay.



[b]Q6[/b]:Is there a chance to add more executions for Warden who currently only have one ?
[b]A[/b]:At the moment, there are no plans to add executions for Warden due to certain limitations. The development team needs to focus on addressing game-related issues first.



[b]Q7[/b]:How does the team handle players who use cheat programs?
[b]A[/b]:Dealing with cheat programs is like dealing with diseases. Even though they may be treated and cured, the development team still has to constantly combat the mutations of these 'diseases.' The team has to evolve the game to handle cheat programs that consistently update themselves, and this approach will continue until no developments in cheat programs are detected and support for such programs ceases. If you encounter or witness the use or promotion of cheat programs, you can directly report it to hshsupport@ygg-cg.com.



[b]Q8[/b]:What is the cause of the Shift Now?
[b]A[/b]:The game restarting itself issue occurs when the game cannot handle the resources of the computer it is running on at that particular moment, or there may be some issues leading to the game restarting on its own. Preliminary problem-solving can be done by adjusting the game settings to be compatible with the computer in use, checking for a stable internet connection, and closing unused programs while playing the game, as they can affect the overall resource management of the computer.

[b]Q9[/b]:In the future, will Jane be able to  choose her own statue for self-ressurect?
[b]A[/b]:The development team has plans to make such skills an inherent ability of Jane, but currently, it is not the appropriate time for the enhancement of those abilities.



[b]Q10[/b]:Matchmaking system operation
[b]A[/b]:In the general mode, matchmaking is calculated based on the scores of the last 5 matches. If a match cannot be found within the specified time, the system calculates the increasing score difference, increasing the chances of encountering opponents from different servers.
In the ranked mode, matchmaking is calculated based on the players' ranks. If a match cannot be found within the specified time, the system calculates the rank difference, increasing the chances for lower-ranked or higher-ranked players to encounter each other if there is an extended matchmaking duration.



[b]Q11[/b]:Is it possible to conduct a test server, select a certain number of players to try out characters that have been buffed and nerfed before adjusting them for actual gameplay?
[b]A[/b]:The development team already has plans in that regard. Stay tuned for updates.



[b]Q12[/b]:Is it possible or not that there will be tournaments on the NA/EU servers in the future?
[b]A[/b]:The development team has surveyed the feedback from players on that server and found that there are still limitations in terms of the player count for organizing competitions. If, in the future, there is a sufficient number of players on that server to facilitate competitions, we will notify you again.



[b]Q13[/b]:Why does the team keep selling skins or accessories continuously instead of taking the time to improve or develop the game first?
[b]A[/b]:The roles of the sales team and the development team are distinct, each with different responsibilities. The sales team and the development team have different responsibilities, depending on the operational plans of each department.

notes.title: Developer Q&A Session#1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44041559/119d2c95a10cd2c32a6f671a2737de16923ccc08.png[/img]

Dear Niwarners,
Our team has gathered and selected questions from Niwarner through various channels, inviting the development team to provide answers to the community.

Players can continue to submit additional questions using [url=https://homesweethomegame.com/en/Q&ADeveloper]this link[/url]. 
The questions submitted by players will be reviewed, selected, and answered by the development team in the next session. If any player wants to know or ask something, feel free to submit your questions.

Thank you to all the players who have joined in submitting questions and supporting our game.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[b][Developer Q&A Session#1][/b]

[b]Q1[/b]: Why did you choose to make Verona unable to flick the mouse instead of changing it to correspond to the effect of Blade Wave?
[b]A[/b]: Enabling Verona to flick her mouse, combined with the assistance of Ghost Coin (Chan's Curse), results in her Blade Wave having an excessively high success rate.



[b]Q2[/b]: Why do you allow the player to walk through the mannequin of Ratri, which contradicts the laws of physics?
[b]A[/b]: The use of Ratri's mannequin as an obstacle provides an excessive advantage compared to other Wardens, especially when compared to the traps of Kamiko. Therefore, adjustments have been made in this area.



[b]Q3[/b]: Why you choose to nerf Ratri instead of buffing other Warden such as Heartrocker for example?
[b]A[/b]: Currently, we are still in the process of testing buffs for several Warden, such as Heartrocker, as well as adjusting the fundamentals of Wardens overall. This includes making reasonable adjustments to blood seek for a more balanced pursuit ability.



[b]Q4[/b]: Could you buff Yuri to enable her to blind and silence the Warden for 5 seconds as she did before?
[b]A[/b]: The team plans to buff the Yuri very soon, but it might not revert to its previous version due to different patches in each version of the game, thus requiring adjustments to suit accordingly.



[b]Q5[/b]: Why there no new Skin of Aisha?
[b]A[/b]: The production of skins for collaborative characters requires consultations with multiple teams. Therefore, the team is currently focused on designing skins for the original characters, especially for those that have few skins. If there are future updates for additional collaboration character skins, we will provide further updates.



[b]Q6[/b]: Why isn't the new map available in the Survive Mode (4v1) at the same time as the Battle Mode (4v4)?
[b]A[/b]: As a nature of the Battle mode (4v4) is easier to balance, so it is opened for play first to gather essential gameplay data for the Survive mode (4v1). Once sufficient data is collected, the map will be released to Survive mode.


[b]Q7[/b]: Why do the servers experience constant lag and remain unresolved?
[b]A[/b]: Initially, it's been found that the issue arises from an excessive amount of data transmission, necessitating optimization. This process will require time to gradually inspect the causes and rectify them.



[b]Q8[/b]: Why haven't various issues, such as the malfunctioning sticker wheel, been resolved yet?
[b]A[/b]: The team hasn't disregarded these issues by any means. However, some problems have yet to uncover their root cause. Some have been addressed but not entirely resolved, or their solutions might have inadvertently affected other system functionalities. This is why random fixes or updates haven't been rolled out to the main system. If we receive valuable information or the actual causes from player reports and our testing, it will facilitate faster progress in addressing these issues.



[b]Q9[/b]: Why doesn't the team listen to players' feedback?
[b]A[/b]: "The team consistently gathers and considers feedback from players through every available channel. However, some issues may have varied and divergent opinions among players. Considering each adjustment necessitates thorough and comprehensive evaluation, which takes time.
Some player suggestions have been tested by the team and found not to align with the game's direction. Therefore, these suggestions have not been implemented in the live servers."



[b]Q10[/b]: How long does the team take to review and fix each bug?
[b]A[/b]: Many factors come into play. If players provide comprehensive information, such as images, video clips, or specific details, to the team, certain issues they encounter might be fixable in the next patch. However, if the problem persists and the cause remains elusive, resolving it might necessitate a prolonged investigation period.



[b]Q11[/b]: Will there be a system in the future to assist new players and reduce the learning curve issue?
[b]A[/b]: At present, the game features new player missions and is undergoing the development of additional systems to assist new players. For instance, there are plans to implement a loading screen tips system and an in-game information button.



[b]Q12[/b]: Does the team have any plans to sell characters as Bullet Coins in the future?
[b]A[/b]: The original characters, which can be purchased by Amethyst, will gradually become available for purchase using Bullet Coin. Stay tuned for announcements on the official page!



[b]Q13[/b]: Can you cosplay a character from a game for a competition?
[b]A[/b]: You can cosplay as the characters in the game and use them for competitions. It's necessary to use the names of the characters as they appear in the game. If you have pictures or videos of your cosplay, don't forget to upload them to the community for others to appreciate your work!



[b]Q14[/b]: If I want to organize my own tournament, can I request support from officials?
[b]A[/b]: That's sound great! You can submit a proposal for in-game tournament support directly to hshsupport@ygg-cg.com. The tournament organizer should provide comprehensive details of the competition, including the event date and complete information about the live streaming channels, for the team's consideration.
